set.body:
Objective
Execute explicit exchangeability/sign-flip/permutation designs with nuisance handling, null-specific recomputation and coherent statistic-family reduction. Consume the independently repaired threshold capability.

Authority and inputs
PRD: docs/plans/unified-mvpa-prd.md v0.2; requirements INF-01, INF-02, INF-03, INF-04, FND-04, FND-09, OPS-02. Scientific/architecture/supplementary notes linked there preserve derivations and rationale. Planning baseline e071e83b3a23bc6f304b1e72625d6281d9cfc9ba plus untracked design documents is provenance, not a clean-tree or current-admission claim. Refresh only relevant sources/pins at claim time.

Owner role and starting seams
statistical integration; randomization compiler; admitted threshold/max-statistic consumer; resample4s streams. These are bounded ownership candidates, not a reservation of whole modules. Reserve exact touched paths when beginning; no assignee is fabricated by this plan.

Prerequisite packets
M4.05, M4.06, M4.07, M3.10, X-THRESH. Native Mote blocking edges are authoritative; stable keys/IDs are mapped in docs/plans/unified-mvpa-epic.md.

Acceptance
1. Each replicate uses the same lawful transformation across all family members; failed members block complete-family inference without erasing usable local estimates.
2. Label-dependent splits or preparation are regenerated or conditioned upon according to the null; only proven target-independent statistics are cached.
3. Plus-one p-values, ties, inclusive thresholds, maximum-statistic decisions and fixed replicate counts agree at boundaries.
4. Worker order/retry changes neither randomization assignment nor family denominators; incomplete runs cannot report completed inference.

Verification
sbt mvpaJVM/test ; in a separate bounded invocation: sbt mvpaJS/test
These are candidate owning-module gates at the planning baseline: resolve any renamed module/test IDs at implementation start, and include affected consumer/parity scenarios. Use independent oracles and explicit tolerances; never report pending tests as passing.

Scope and handoff
Implement only this packet and required owner-local tests/docs. Reuse Gale/Multivar kernels, resample4s designs, Alder lifecycle and existing response/locus/estimates facilities; provider gaps stay explicit and require consumer admission. Do not add legacy enum cases or permanent compatibility wrappers, duplicate orchestration, a new registry/runtime, broad repo refactors, or silently change the scientific estimand to pass a resource/statistical gate. Migrate/delete per the M0 ledger. No Git push/release publication or foreign-store mutation is authorized by this ticket.
At handoff attach exact revisions, commands/results, scenario IDs, failure/caveat status, artifacts and next consumer. Semantic, numerical, scope, resource and scientific evidence remain separate. Independent audit tickets must use independently derived expectations/review, not repeat the implementation helper; unresolved criteria keep the task open.
set.title: UMVPA-M4.08: Integrate lawful randomization, family-complete multiplicity, and null invalidation
